verdict_rationale: Comprehensive code-level inspection and offline regression testing confirmed that the Phase 4F.4.3 execution engine satisfies all execution safety, client isolation, authorization concurrency, crash durability, TOCTOU tamper resistance, and telemetry integrity requirements. Multi-process competition tests (up to 20 concurrent workers) prove atomic single-use authorization consumption under fcntl.flock(LOCK_EX). Process termination tests under SIGKILL verify that pre-commit crashes preserve valid authorization while post-commit crashes fail closed. Byte-level manifest hashing and single-parse execution eliminate TOCTOU risks. Image pinning via repository@digest prevents mutable tag resolution. Artifact directories are namespaced by unique execution ID preventing overwrites. Missing telemetry remains UNAVAILABLE without synthetic 0.0 default substitution. All 260 tests pass cleanly.

1_authorization_concurrency_and_crash_sa.findings: None. File locking covers read, validation, consumed update, fsync, atomic rename, and directory fsync. Real multiprocessing tests (10 and 20 workers) confirmed zero double-consumption races. SIGKILL termination tests confirmed clean recovery before rename and fail-closed defense after rename.

2_manifest_integrity_and_toctou.findings: None. Exact manifest bytes are read once, hashed, parsed, and executed directly from memory via verified_schedule. Post-verification on-disk tampering has zero effect on in-memory trial schedule.

3_container_identity.findings: None. Immutable repository@digest reference (postgres@sha256:cf78e76683b9ca8c5733cbbdce6c9262b45b6767934dd0a95e671f9a0fc20685) is passed directly to docker run. Container effective resources and RepoDigests are verified before warm-up.

4_artifact_durability_and_collision_safe.findings: None. Artifact output is namespaced under artifacts/phase_4f4_empirical/{execution_id}. Reusing non-empty directories is rejected before authorization consumption. Latest pointer updates atomically without overwriting historical runs.

5_measurement_integrity.findings: None. Missing telemetry is strictly preserved as UNAVAILABLE with mean: None and reduction: None. Measured zero (0.0) is clearly distinguishable from missing telemetry.

6_end_to_end_execution_control_flow.findings: None. Complete 14-stage lifecycle traced. Any stage failure aborts the trial, persists failure evidence, and marks the campaign as FAILED without producing condition summaries or comparison deltas.

7_test_quality.findings: None. 260 tests pass offline. Real filesystem operations, multiprocessing, SIGKILL process termination, and advisory locking are exercised without excessive mocking.
